title: CI: Retry electron-builder packaging steps (avoid transient 5xx download failures)
description:
The Release workflow's desktop builds can fail on transient download errors from GitHub releases (e.g., electron-builder nsis-resources 502) during `npx electron-builder --win`.

Fix:
- Wrap the OS-specific packaging steps (`electron-builder --mac/--win/--linux`) in a small retry loop with backoff.

Acceptance:
- Transient 5xx download failures do not fail the entire workflow on the first attempt.
- If failures persist after retries, the job still fails (no silent success).
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Added retry loops around electron-builder packaging steps for mac/win/linux
